en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a long historic building complex with steep masonry terraces and arched supports on a hillside above landscaped gardens and a path. A spire rises from the central block, suggesting a chapel or small tower. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the path in the foreground. The sky is filled with streaked clouds. The image has a printed margin and handwritten catalog-like numbers along the right edge.
